vectors.draft: `manifestHash` MUST be the SHA-256 of the signed Trade Manifest COSE bytes and MUST NOT include the issuer public key encoding.
vectors.note: Appendix A manifest COSE. Expected digest is RFC 6234 over those octets, not a tstr member and not the public key.

vectors.draft: `receiptHash` is the SHA-256 of the receipt's signed COSE bytes, encoded as lowercase hex.
A verifier MUST report every settlement record whose timestampMs falls outside [windowStartMs, windowEndMs) as extract-scope-mismatch.
The extract window is half-open [windowStartMs, windowEndMs).
A receipt with outcome = settled MUST have a non-null x402PaymentRef.
noManifest MUST be true if and only if manifestHash is null.

A verifier presented with a Trade Manifest MUST compare the amount, currency and settlement time of every presented receipt that names it against the manifest's amount, currency and expiry, and MUST report a receipt that departs from them.

vectors.note: -03 states a single branch: a departing receipt is reported as manifest-terms-mismatch and fails the audit. This tree walks the attested set when a pin is usable, so a receipt that does not verify under the pin cannot invent that charge. The vector records the companion; the split is a finding about the draft, not a licence to invent a -04 sentence.

vectors.draft: A verifier presented with a Trade Manifest MUST compare the amount, currency and settlement time of every receipt that names it against the manifest amount, currency and expiry, and MUST report a receipt that departs from them. Where no usable issuer key is pinned, the departure MUST still be reported and MUST NOT by itself fail the audit.
vectors.note: -03 stated a single branch that failed the audit on an unpinned departure, and this tree warned instead; the split was recorded here and named in UPGRADING. -04 is posted with the two-branch form, for the reason given where the requirement is defined: a charge no key stands behind is one a forged receipt can invent against an honest payer. The companion and the posted draft now agree, so this is an ordinary vector.

vectors.draft: MUST report a presented manifest that no presented receipt references.

A PDP allow decision MUST be bound to the SHA-256 of the canonical encoding of the request fields it evaluated, as stated in Section 7.1, and MUST be single-use. Section 7.1 states the request document member by member: exactly six members, amount as the decimal string and never a JSON number, tool and manifestHash null when absent, encoded per RFC 8785 and hashed over its UTF-8 octets.
vectors.note: -03 named a hash of the request fields and neither the octets nor the digest, so this vector recorded that silence and carried no expected value: writing one would have recorded the companion's answer as though it were the draft's. -04 is posted and names the digest, the encoding and the exact document, so the expected value is now derivable from the text and is recorded here. A reader implementing -04 from the text alone who computes a different digest has found a defect, in one of us.

vectors.draft: Table 3 names policyHash as lowercase hex SHA-256. Appendix A of the posted -04 still carries policyHash=aa on a signed receipt.
vectors.note: Companion now enforces Table 3 and refuses to sign the appendix claims. The vector is re-signed in -05; this tree does not re-sign it.
